Jonas Weber (Business User, Department Marketing) signs in to the Portal with a magic link read from the lab Mailpit, in his own browser context.

scenarios.expected: One Request has the supplied values and successful attachments and appears for its Requester. Missing required values prevent submission; attachment failure is reported without concealing a successfully created Request.
scenarios.actual: 18 recorded steps passed in one run (log walkthrough.json, run 1): 16 as Jonas in the browser, including the two Department Row checks, and 2 as Nadia (an API read and a browser form check). Jonas read Before you submit on the Portal home (five links) and opened the DOC-030 request type card at /portal/new/<slug>; the form showed its own Before you submit link beside the questions. Under About your request the labels came in this order: Title, Department, Urgency, Description, Counterparties, Our entity, Term type, Value (Amount, Currency, Frequency in one Row), Business reason, Business reviewer, Attachments. Title, Department, Urgency, Description and Business reason carried an asterisk. Department started at Marketing (his own) and Urgency at Medium with Low, Medium, High, Critical. An empty Submit request said "Fill Title, Description, and DOC-030 portal Business reason 1790330794487 first — the form requires them.", marked each question and sent no POST. Expiry date was absent until Term type was set to fixed; then it carried an asterisk and a submit named it; evergreen hid it and fixed showed the kept answer 2027-03-31. Our entity offered Not set plus exactly the three Portal-listed Entities out of 50 in the registry. The person question offered only Not set and had no asterisk. Counterparties found Litware Insurance Company for "Lit", then Add new took a typed name; the first was marked Primary. Choose files with 21 files kept 20 and said "A request carries at most 20 files."; Remove took files off; one chosen and one dropped file were listed. Submit request sent one POST. The confirmation read "Thanks! Your request has been submitted to legal.", showed "Attaching your files…" while the uploads were held, then cleared, with no failure and no R- reference. Open request showed the meta line "R-91 · DOC-030 portal Evaluation review 1790330794487 · Submitted Sep 25" and What you submitted with the description, Procurement, High, both Counterparties, the Entity, Term type, Expiry date, Value, Business reason and both files (downloads matched the original bytes), with no edit control. Your requests listed "R-91 … Legal Owner: Not assigned yet Open" once. Nadia's read showed status new and no converted record. Nadia, with no profile Department, saw "Choose a Department" and "Fill Department first — the form requires it.". An aborted upload confirmed "This file did not attach. Quote R-92 and send it to Legal another way." with the filename; R-92 was saved without the file and the file went on a reply. A decline during upload showed "Add it to a reply on R-93"; the link opened the Declined Request's composer and the file went on a reply. An unknown form address returned to /portal. An aborted submission said "The request could not be submitted.", kept the Title, showed no confirmation and saved no Request.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and the technical reviewer; not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.

The work2 lab (openlaw-docs-80ceef9e-work2) is shared with other DOC-030 agents. This walkthrough created only records named DOC-030 portal: one Portal-listed Entity, three contract-scoped catalog Fields, one Contract type with its own Form, one request type that targets it, one type-specific Before you submit link, and the Requests and records named in the log. It changed no seeded record and no organization setting. Development runs before the recorded run left further DOC-030 portal Requests (R-36 to R-48); they are not credited.

Sign-in link requests are budgeted per email address and per client address, and other agents also sign in as Jonas Weber. So one fresh magic link per Business User was read from Mailpit and its browser session was kept outside the repository and reused for the recorded run.
The confirmation carries no R- reference unless a file fails, as the author found. The walkthrough read the reference from the Open request meta line and from Your requests.

The V-C09 prerequisite "required Fields" was met by required Intake Rows on the destination type's Form (Description and a required catalog Field), because since DD-028 the request type itself carries no Fields.
The upload failure and the submission failure used browser route interception (aborted requests). The decline race used a held upload and a real API decline by the Legal Team Member.

The 20-Requests-per-hour and 256 MB-per-hour limits were not exercised; they come from source constants. The shared lab's hourly budget for Jonas was also needed by other agents. No file-size limit was exercised.

Product bug, not a guide failure: the Portal Term type question lists raw stored values (fixed, auto_renew, evergreen), and What you submitted shows "Term type fixed" and "Value frequency one_time". The guide's Fixed and Evergreen still name the same choices.

Author limitation checked: when an Administrator puts the built-in Department Row On intake form, the Portal asks Department twice (the required Department basic and an optional second Department that starts at Not set). R-94 stored Procurement as its Department and Engineering in the second answer; Legal's read showed Procurement, but conversion gave C-338 the Department Engineering. The guide does not describe this configuration, and its sentence that conversion carries the Department to the new record does not hold there. Recorded as a product bug in the log. The fixture Form was put back afterwards.
The Help and notification-preference links in Related guides were not followed.
